notes: Provenance rows for every in-repo file that carries third-party-derived content, or whose build/run boundary touches the pinned GPL-3.0-or-later trees. Required by AGENTS.md ('record file/table-level provenance before adopting any third-party code, table, or asset'; 'copying Surge-derived code, tables, or assets into this repository requires a visible license decision record before merge') and by docs/REUSE-AUDIT.md 'Adoption mechanics'. Governance issue #25 (SXT-019) owns this file.

A row is not a ratification. Most cited records are PROPOSED - pending owner ratification; the record's own Status line is authoritative and this project has made no distribution-license determination.
Rows describe repository content only. The pinned Surge engine, its presets, the SST submodules and the Airwindows sources stay OUTSIDE this repository; no row here authorizes copying them in.

tools/check_provenance.py enforces this file: stale rows, uncorroborated rows, blanket patterns, exemptions of non-exemptible rules, and unattributed carriage signals all fail. Run it (and --negative-control) before merging anything that adds third-party-derived content.

DELAY_TIME_TABLES - the 16x4 delay_time constants transcribed from Reverb1::loadpreset(). Structure re-implemented and cited; no SST code copied.

exemptions.reason: The decision records ARE the provenance documents. They quote upstream constants inside the record that authorizes them and state their own pin, license and status; requiring a provenance row for a record would be circular.
The reuse survey discusses what may and may not be copied (including upstream's own vendoring) and adopts nothing itself: 'survey evidence recommends, it does not install'.

Evidence records describe provenance decisions in prose ('quoted as data', 'QUOTED constants') while carrying no third-party content of their own; they are this project's own measurements. The non-exemptible rules (foreign license text, upstream asset extensions, foreign-language source) still apply to reports/, so a vendored file cannot hide there.
Same as reports/**/*.md: machine-readable evidence metadata that restates the licensing/provenance line of the leaf it documents.

States that the Airwindows headers are vendored in the UPSTREAM engine tree (not a submodule at the pinned commit). It describes upstream's layout for the leaf generator; no upstream content is carried here.

This manifest describes what is quoted where; its rows necessarily use the quotation vocabulary. It carries no third-party content of its own. Note that the non-exemptible rules still apply to it: a copyright line or license body pasted into a row's prose fails the audit (it did, during this file's authoring, and the row was reworded rather than exempted).

The audit implementation contains the vocabulary it detects plus the synthetic negative-control fixtures. Its license-body / copyright / citation fixtures are assembled from fragments at run time precisely so the NON-exemptible rules keep applying to this file too - no self-path special case exists in the tool.
The audit's test suite, same reason as tools/check_provenance.py; it reuses that module's fragment-assembled fixtures rather than pasting signal text.
